description: This PHP source file defines the class 'jjwg_Address_Cache', which extends 'jjwg_Address_Cache_sugar'. It manages address caching functionalities including retrieving, saving, and deleting address cache records, as well as validating geographic coordinates. It interacts with database tables and external modules related to maps and address caching within a SugarCRM environment.

classes.name: jjwg_Address_Cache
classes.description: A class for managing address cache data, including retrieval, storage, validation, and deletion of address records within the system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the address cache object and loads configuration settings if requested.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads configuration settings for address caching from global variables and initializes map module.

methods.name: getAddressCacheInfo
methods.description: Retrieves address cache information from the database based on provided address or geocode info.

methods.name: saveAddressCacheInfo
methods.description: Saves new address cache data into the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: deleteAllAddressCache
methods.description: Deletes all address cache records and audit logs from the database.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Validates if a longitude value is within the acceptable range (-180 to 180).

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Validates if a latitude value is within the acceptable range (-90 to 90).
